tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ti pus mdzad pa ro snyoms skor drug gi rtsa tshig bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ gu h+ya man+d+ra dharma ṣa ṭa nā ma/ bod skad du/ gsang sngags chos drug zhes bya ba/ dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang mchod brjod chen bla ma rnams dang ni// dgyes pa rigs bsdus kyi rdo rje rigs lnga lha mo rig mar bcas// dpa' bo dpa' mo rgyud sde bzhi'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug la sogs la// rigs mthun gus pas dad phyir rjes su 'dud/ rtog pa lam bshad par dam bca' khyer ro snyoms rtsa ba drug gi don// slob dpon nā ro mai tris la sogs mdo gur rtag gnyis saṃ bū ṭi gsang 'dus rgyud sa bcu pa'i kun gyi nang gsungs pa// mdor bsdus gces pa'i snying po zab la ma nor bri bar rigs// rnam rtog mdor bstan nas nyon mongs lha 'dre dang*// nad gdon byang sems bar do rnams// lam khyer rtsa ba rnam drug las// drug drug sum cu drug tu gsungs// phye bas brgya dang brgyad du 'gyur// de dang po phyir rtsa ba'i lam drug bstan// gdod nas stong rgyas bshad las rnam rtog lam khyer bstan pa pa'i rang bzhin la// glo bur rkyen bas ngar 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog /ma rig pa gyur pa bdun la sogs pa la sogs rang bzhin brgyad cu mched// 'dod chags la zhe sdang gti mug sogs nyon mongs brgyad khrir smin// rgyu rkyen rnam par rtog pa tshogs nyon mongs pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mu mthar med par lhung*// sdug bsngal nyid 'bras bu bsrings 'gro drug gnas su yang nas yang du 'khor// las ngan la sems can sna tshogs pa rnams de bzhin spyod// de phyir rkyen bla ma dam pa bsten nas 'bad pas rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs kyi pad mo sten// 'jigs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la pas bsag sbyang gnyis la 'bad// rnam rtog rgyu ma rig chen po des// 'khor ba'i gnas rgya mtshor dus dpag tu med bar mnar/ ro/ /rtog pa med par ting nge 'dzin mchog thob na/

bar gyur/ /mi chos nyid gnas pa mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur*// rnam par rtog pa la brten nas rtog pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin btsal/ rnam par/ /rtog pa dang bcas rnam pa dang rtog pa med pa gnyis la/ sa /zhi gnas ting nge 'dzin dang lhag mthong sgom par bya zhing*/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong*/ /zung 'jug shes na nyon mongs de nyid las grol/ sems nyid kyi don/ /ma rtogs rtog pas 'khrul pa sna tshogs 'byung*/ sems nyid skye med du/ /rtogs pa'i rtog pa rnam dag chos skur 'gyur// 'dod nyon mongs pa lam du khyer ba chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// ser sna phrag dog nga rgyal te// 'dod zhen yid 'khrul rnam rmongs pa// 'khris zhing zur smod nga che ste// yi dwags sems dmyal dud 'gro dang*// bse rags lha min ltung bar skye// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// ser sna nga rgyal khro las grol// yid 'ong byams ldan shes rab can// longs spyod mthu ldan kun gyis bkur// nyon mongs grol ba chos nyid do// gang zag brgyad po la zhugs thob// gsang sngags rigs mthun lam du khyer// dug lnga ye shes lngar shes nas// thabs dang ldan pas rab bsten na// mi 'ching grol bas thar pa thob// bzlog pa'i sgom pa 'di nyid ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi gzhan gyis min shes// re dogs rtsa ba ma chod na// phan gnod lha 'dre dpag med bshad// rnam rtog lha srin sde brgyad de// legs nyes cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston// yid 'ong nyams dga' rang lha dang*// dus rtags kha dog mi gdug 'jigs// bden brdzun zhen yul mnga' ltas kyang*// 'jigs smyo gsod gcod 'du shes dang*// skye med dran nyams rnal 'byor zhig /chos min bya bas gnod mang tshe 'dir khrid// lam gol ba dang log par 'gro// des na re dogs 'khris thag bcad// stong nyid snying rje'i dkyil 'khor nas// rang nyid ye shes he ru ka

/'jigs med gar gyi nyams 'bar ba// rnam rtog re dogs zas su za// mtshan mo gcer bu dur khrod rgyu// nyin mo dug lnga 'dod yon spyod// dug gsum las byung nad rnams ni// rlung mkhris bad kan 'du ba 'khrugs// spyod lam ngan dang gnas kyi rkyen// glo bur rkyen dang kha zas log /las dang dal yams lha 'dre'i nad// sngon las nyon mongs las gyur ni// nam zla dus tshod na so dang*// na sa na dus stod smad dang*// tsha grang kha zas ngo gdong dang*// rigs kyi dbye ba ngos 'dzin dang*// dri dang kha dog reg bya dang*// re dogs rkyen gyis nad ngos bzung*// 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa mtshan bcas dang*// rtsa rlung thig le kha sbyor dang*// lha dang sngags dang rten 'brel dang*// zlog sgom go zlog dug bsten dang*// stong nyid snying rje byang sems dang*// bka' drin che bas drin du bzung*// khams gsum sems can pha ma yin// drin can 'gro drug sdug bsngal mnar// dus 'dir phan btags khrel yod ngo tsha can// sems skyed khas blangs dang ldan par// sngon gyi sangs rgyas mdzad pa bzhin// dngos sam brgyud pas phan 'dogs bya// las lus smin pa'i 'gro ba la// snying rje'i phan gnod dngos su brje// 'jug sems dgos pas 'gro ba 'dzin// rang 'dod gang byas sems bskyed rnams// byang chub 'dod na gzhan bde bsgrub// sangs rgyas byang chub spyod bzhin mdzad// gang la gnod byed byang chub de la bskul// sbyor ba rtsub par gyur na myur du drangs// nad sogs 'gro ba nyam thag pa// bde sdug dngos su brje bar bya// 'jug pas dngos su phan 'dogs shing*// de las log na gzhan ci phan// gang zhig skyes nas 'chi 'gyur bas// de bas 'chi ba lam khyer gces// rang nyid grol 'gyur 'chi bas ma gtugs kyang*// sngon du sbyang ba rnam gsum brten// bla ma dbang dang byin rlabs dang*/ nyams myong rtogs pa brtan pa dang*// rmi lam la sogs drod tshad blta// 'pho ba la sogs shes par bya// bar do gsum la mtshams sbyar zhing*// dug gsum bsres la lam khyer bya// tshogs bsag las kyi lam la brten// 'byung ba thim rtags shes par bya// dbugs song rang bzhin 'od gsal 'char// bsgom pa'i don dang bsres la gzhag

/'od gsal dbyer med bar do 'gag /de nyid sngon du ma gyur na// sngon byung la sogs bdun phrag 'byung*// chags sdang bzlog nas 'od gsal bsgom// der kyang zin par ma gyur na// rigs dang skye gnas bzung bar bya// smon lam las 'phro bzang pos ni// de bzhin nyid du skye ba gzhan// mkha' spyod mngon par dga' ba thob// chos sku rnam rtog 'od gsal las// mtshan ma gzugs sku lnga ldan ni// longs sku dag pa gnyis ldan thob// sprul pa drug ni 'gro drug tu// gang du srid pa rgyun mi 'chad// tha mal pa yi gzugs las kyang*// 'gro ba'i don ni dpag med 'byung*// de phyir ro snyoms rtogs bya'i phyir// dam tshig rnams ni tshul bzhin bsrung*// stong nyid snying rje rgyun du bsgom// kun la bla ma'i rnal 'byor shis// dbang bskur byin rlabs thob pa dang*// tshogs kyi 'khor los dus drug mchod// snod ldan rnams la rdzogs par sbyin// dam pa min la gsang bar bya// rgyud sde bzhi yi bcud bsdus pa// khong gi snying phyung lta bu'i gnad// sbas pa mig 'byed gsal byed 'di// gab pa'i snying po gces pa'i sgron ma kun// rgyud nas gsungs dang zab pa'i gdams ngag rnams// dpal ldan nā ro pa las legs rnyed pa// kun la phan phyir skal ldan gcig la sbyin// bdag 'dra gcig la lung bstan te// skal ldan gcig gis len par 'gyur// 'gro la phan pa'i blo gros can// chos kyi spyan gyi gzigs nas kyang*// gnad kyi nying khu thob par shog /ro snyoms rtsa ba drug gsum pa// bdud rtsi thugs kyi nying khu zhes bya ba// bla ma ti pu'i zhal nas gsungs pa// bla ma ras chung pas bod du gdan drangs pa'o// // sa ma ya na ra kan/ gter mdzod ma rnams ni/ rin po che rgya ras pas lho brag mkhar chu'i brag lcags phur can nas gter nas phyung ba'o// ro snyoms skor drug gi rtsa ba gsum gyi dang po/

rje btsun til+li pas mdzad/ til+li pa'i gsang tshig bya ba yin/ bar pa de nā ro pas mdzad/ spyod pa chos kyi glu bya ba yin/ nad lam khyer gyi rtsa ba sogs/ phyi ma 'di rnams rje btsun ti pus mdzad/ des skor drug ka'i rtsa ba tshang bar bzhugs so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
